# EcoPulse

> A student-centered gamified eco-rewards platform

EcoPulse aims to empower students to understand their eco-impact on the world around them by showing them the impact they produce while completing eco-challenges, while promoting environmentally friendly actions through points, leaderboards, and rewards.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ecopulse.dev): Landing page with call to action and more info
- [Pricing](https://ecopulse.dev/feed): Challenge feed with challenges for student to do
- [Sign up](https://ecopulse.dev/leaderboard): Leaderboard of students
## Other Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/saiptheking/ecopulse): Open source code
